english.title: Cause use of vehicle - obligatory lights not complying with regulation 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused the use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY OBLIGATORY LAMP(S)/REFLECTOR(S)/REAR MARKING(S)/DEVICE(S)..) which complied with regulation 18(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH(ES )..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(1)of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use of a vehicle on a road obligatory lamp(s)/reflector(s)/rear marking(s)/device(s)
did not comply/work/perform in accordance with reg 18(1)

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY LAMP(S)/REFLECTOR(S)/REAR MARKING(S)/DEVICE(S)..) which complied with regulations in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH(ES )..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
